manifest.purpose: The correct recovered Verilog module named pwm_deadtime_gen with ports clk, rst, en, duty[3:0], pwm_hi (output reg), pwm_lo (output reg), matching the pinned interface exactly. Implements a 4-bit free-running counter cnt[3:0] incrementing every cycle when en=1, holding when en=0, synchronously reset to 0 on rst=1 (one-cycle latency, standard sync reset). pwm_hi and pwm_lo are registered (Moore) outputs computed combinationally each cycle from the CURRENT cnt and duty (stateA = (cnt>=2) && (cnt<duty); stateB = (cnt>=duty+2)) and then latched into pwm_hi/pwm_lo on the next posedge clk, reproducing the exact one-cycle registered latency described in the interface contract (mirrors the structure of obfuscated_rtl.v's stateA/stateB with n1..n4/counter, but with clean word-level cnt and duty comparisons instead of flattened single-bit nets). On rst=1, pwm_hi and pwm_lo are forced to 0 in the same registered stage. This file is standalone-compilable with iverilog and contains no dependency on gate_netlist.v or obfuscated_rtl.v. It is the single file graded by evaluate.py when copied to submission/recovered_rtl.v.
